items.title: Trials excluded women without a smartphone
items.whyItMatters: The largest trial excluded them, and uptake is lower among women needing an interpreter (c4).
items.opportunity: Include loan phones, paper diaries with hub calls, and interpreter calls; report outcomes by digital access and language.

items.title: Readmission cannot be the primary outcome
items.whyItMatters: Differences in readmission are small and underpowered (c2).
items.opportunity: Use control at six weeks as the primary outcome and report readmission and severe episodes as secondary.

items.title: Out-of-hours high readings
items.whyItMatters: The hub closes at 20:00; severe readings at night go to the assessment unit.
items.opportunity: Count out-of-hours escalations as a process measure.

items.title: Monitor accuracy and cuff size
items.whyItMatters: One of three monitors underestimated systolic pressure at high readings.
items.opportunity: Use validated monitors and check cuff size at discharge.

errorsFound: A discovery lead gave its publication year as text; it was read as 2021 and remains an unverified lead.
reevaluation: The gaps support a pragmatic trial with inclusive delivery, control at six weeks as the primary outcome and readmission as secondary.
summary: Four gaps; digital exclusion is high severity.
